description: This file declares functions related to formatted printing functions used within the curl project, such as curl_mprintf and curl_mfprintf, providing variadic and va_list based interfaces.

methods.name: curl_mprintf
methods.description: Formatted print to stdout with variadic arguments.

methods.name: curl_mfprintf
methods.description: Formatted print to a FILE pointer with variadic arguments.

methods.name: curl_msprintf
methods.description: Formatted print to string buffer with variadic arguments.

methods.name: curl_msnprintf
methods.description: Formatted print to string buffer with maximum length, variadic arguments.

methods.name: curl_mvprintf
methods.description: Formatted print to stdout with va_list arguments.

methods.name: curl_mvfprintf
methods.description: Formatted print to FILE with va_list arguments.

methods.name: curl_mvsprintf
methods.description: Formatted print to string buffer with va_list arguments.

methods.name: curl_mvsnprintf
methods.description: Formatted print to string buffer with max length, va_list.

methods.name: curl_maprintf
methods.description: Allocate and format string with variadic arguments.

methods.name: curl_mvaprintf
methods.description: Allocate and format string with va_list.
